question: For the customer who paid 634.8 in 2012/8/25, what was the consumption decrease rate from Year 2012 to 2013?
actual_sql:
WITH target_customer AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT customer_id
  FROM transactions_1k
  WHERE date = DATE '2012-08-25'
    AND ROUND(amount * price, 2) = 634.8
),
annual_consumption AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN date LIKE '2012%' THEN consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
    SUM(CASE WHEN date LIKE '2013%' THEN consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013
  FROM yearmonth
  WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM target_customer)
)
SELECT
  tc.customer_id,
  ac.consumption_2012,
  ac.consumption_2013,
  ROUND((ac.consumption_2012 - ac.consumption_2013) / NULLIF(ac.consumption_2012, 0), 4) AS decrease_rate
FROM target_customer tc
CROSS JOIN annual_consumption ac
ORDER BY tc.customer_id;
